fields.title: Panama tender record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Both 'list' and 'detail' mode records pass through DGCP's own OCDS 'compiledRelease' object close to verbatim (ocid, tender, awards, contracts, buyer, parties, etc.) -- extra fields may appear beyond those listed here as the upstream schema evolves.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: 'list' mode: an object with the startCursor filter used to produce this run. 'detail' mode: the OCDS ocid requested, as a plain string. Left untyped here since the shape differs by mode.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-ocds-records-api (a 'list' mode page result), S1-ocds-record-detail (a 'detail' mode fetch), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (zero records at this cursor, or an unknown ocid in detail mode), blocked_or_transient (network/server issue after retries).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_nextCursor.title: Next page cursor
_nextCursor.description: Present only on the last record of a 'list' run that stopped because it reached maxResults (feed had more pages available). Pass this value as the 'startCursor' input on a future run to continue where this one left off -- the upstream feed has no date/keyword filter, so this is the only way to see more of it.

ocid.title: OCDS ocid
ocid.description: The Open Contracting ID for this tender -- feed this into 'detail' mode's 'ocid'/'ocids' input for a fresh single-record fetch.

id.title: Release ID
id.description: The compiled release's own id (ocid plus a compile timestamp).

date.title: Release date
date.description: Date of the most recent event compiled into this release.

tag.title: Release tag
tag.description: OCDS release tag array, always ['compiled'] for these records.

publishedDate.title: Published date
publishedDate.description: When this compiled release was published to the feed.

language.title: Language
language.description: OCDS language code, always 'es' (Spanish) for Panama's data.

buyer.title: Buyer
buyer.description: The government buyer's id and name.

parties.title: Parties
parties.description: Every organization involved (buyer, procuringEntity, supplier(s)), each with an id, name, roles array, and PA-RUC identifier where available.

planning.title: Planning
planning.description: Budget breakdown reference for this procurement, when available.

tender.title: Tender
tender.description: The tender itself: id, title, description, status/statusDetails (e.g. 'complete'/'Adjudicado'), procurementMethod(Details), awardCriteria(Details), mainProcurementCategory(Details), procuringEntity, publishedDate, and 'uri' (a link back into PanamaCompra's own SPA).

awards.title: Awards
awards.description: Award(s) made for this tender -- value/currency (PAB), status/statusDetails, date, line items (UNSPSC classification, description, quantity, unit), and supplier(s). Empty or absent if not yet awarded.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.description: Signed contract(s) -- value, status, period, and documents (each with a direct download 'url' on apisv3.panamacompra.gob.pa, documentType, and dates). Empty or absent if no contract has been signed yet.

relatedProcesses.title: Related processes
relatedProcesses.description: Links to related OCDS processes, e.g. the planning-stage record this tender originated from.

dataSegmentation.title: Data segmentation
dataSegmentation.description: Upstream's own year/month partition metadata for this record.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Which underlying PanamaCompra system version produced this record, e.g. 'panamacompra_v3' (the current live platform) or 'panamacompra_v2' (the prior one).
